page.layout: One page of text, with one marginal note in the right margin beside the first lines. Running head at top, page number at top right. Below the text: catchword at right and gathering signature at left.

main_text.p: ab imperatore exercitus assignatam deferere, turpe est & ignominiosum. Verum Anton. Matth. loc.allegaggressorem, quem te inferiorem & viribus & armis novisti, ad tempus vitasse, non in probro, sed in laude positum erit. Ne dicas, iniquam fore commutationem, si quis ob tutelam honoris, qui ad mores probos non spectat, nec reipublicae utilis est, vitam adimat proximo. Cùm ille quidem resarciri possit, haec vero nunquam repeti, aut revocari.
main_text.head: CAP. XXIII.
main_text.p: NOn semper ad justam defensionem requiritur, ut quis percutiat, aut inferat vulnus, verum quandoque sufficit armorum metus, atque terror.

page.notes: The marginal note is printed as three short lines ("Anton." / "Matth." / "loc.alleg") and is transcribed as one note, beside the lines "ag-" to "inferiorem". The page is speckled with ink spots and stains, none affecting the letters. "vitasse" and "Cùm" are as printed. No doubtful readings.
